name: Town Waterworks
description: The town waterworks chain increases growth and province-wide sanitation by providing better water distribution and storage in all regions.

variants.name: Well
variants.short: Precious water for the whole community to share.
variants.flavour: Water storage was a basic but essential part of life in barbarian kingdoms of late antiquity, and their populations needed a constant supply. Theoderic the Great, king of the Ostrogoths between AD475 and AD526, started to look for ways to improve the lives of ordinary people. He believed that many aspects of Roman culture should be preserved in the towns and cities in which they settled. Stretches of lead pipe have been found in Ravenna, the former Roman and later Ostrogothic capital, upon which Theoderic’s restoration of the Roman water supply system was proclaimed for posterity. This must’ve been an important step in legitimising his rule over many former Roman subjects.

effects.text: Sanitation: +1 to all regions in this province (province to each region)
